user.title: Connect to MuPiBox-NG
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local MuPiBox-NG API. The admin password is optional and is only needed for protected maintenance actions such as rescan, restart, reboot and power off.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address without http:// or https://.
data_description.port: MuPiBox-NG listens on port 8090 by default.
data_description.use_ssl: Enable only when MuPiBox-NG is reached through an HTTPS reverse proxy.
data_description.admin_password: Leave empty if no admin password is configured or if Home Assistant should only use public player/status functions.

error.invalid_auth: The MuPiBox-NG admin password is invalid.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to MuPiBox-NG.

abort.already_configured: This MuPiBox-NG endpoint is already configured.
